purpose: Screen-scope observation leg (Rev20 §20.2): one read-only screen capture taken before the first authorized input; accepted only if the frozen v3 locate_album_card.py returns ELIGIBLE on a located window crop at scale 2 or scale 1.

probe.sound: none (-x: silent, no cursor drawn, no window highlight)

window_localization.method: alignment of the 2x-upscaled AX-window frame (/tmp/route5_frame_pre.jpg, 327x643 from app.getScreenshot) against the probe by a mean-absolute-difference search over the window origin; full-probe coarse search (step 8, template subsampled step 8) with a clear unique minimum (7.134 next-vs 11.256) then refinement to step 1 with the full template
window_localization.template: frame rows 400-500 @1x, columns 0-200 @1x (2x rows 800-1000, columns 0-400) — contains the target card row text and excludes the ellipsis-control rectangle (control x≈300 @1x lies outside the template columns, so the alignment cannot be biased by the control)
cross_checks: frame title bbox [17,435,126,455] -> screen [34,932,252,972]; the frozen v3 locator independently reads the same title inside the scale-1 crop at bbox [17,435,126,446] with texts ["2024/05/13~05/17"] - match
scale-1 crop vs the pre frame: mean absolute difference 1.608 gray levels over the full 327x643 crop (no sampling) - the crop is content-identical to the app frame apart from screen->frame resampling
the crashed first pass had independently found the same match at (0,862) (~ MAD 3.117 sampled); corrected origin = match - (0,800) = [0,62]
window_localization.note: The first localization pass mis-read the template-match position as the window origin and crashed before writing crops; it was corrected (origin = match minus the template's window offset (0,800) in 2x space) and re-run. The crashed pass sent no input and produced no accepted artifact.

acceptance.rule: exit 0 + decodable + frozen v3 locate_album_card.py ELIGIBLE on the located window crop at scale 2 or scale 1

crop_scale_2.note: at 2x the frozen locator's scale-1 count-box geometry reads only '5' of '57', so this scale is not accepted; the title is still read, proving the crop contains the real window content

crop_scale_1.equality_with_the_pre_frame_run: same verdict (ELIGIBLE) and same title texts and left/top edges as the S3 run on the pre frame; bbox bottom edge ([..,446] vs [..,455]) and click point ([29,440] vs [29,445]) differ by <=5 px due to the screen->frame resampling; the click point actually used for input #1 is S3's current-frame-derived [29,445] (album-card-locate.json), never this crop's

acceptance.ordering_local: pre frame 17:03:22 -> AX 17:03:23 -> S3 locate 17:03:39 -> probe 17:05:02 -> localization+crops 17:10:57 -> acceptance scale2 exit5 / scale1 exit0 17:11:33-34 -> input #1 never sent (surface abort 17:11..17:12:37; see run-ledger seq 5)

permission_prompt_check.method: no permission dialogue appeared on any readable surface: the probe decoded and the run continued; the intended post-probe AX byte-identity re-read could not be performed because the window became unbindable at ~17:11 (CU server -10005 cgWindowNotFound) - the failure itself is recorded, and the subsequent read-only observations found no permission surface (run-ledger seq 5)
permission_prompt_check.consequence: no permission-prompt abort; the run instead aborted read-only on surface-unavailability before any input

environment_note.event: pre-input surface unavailable; attempt-05 stopped read-only with zero inputs sent
environment_note.binding_attempts: LINE isRunning=true (cua.listApps); cua.getApp failed 3 times with 'Computer Use server error -10005: cgWindowNotFound' (bundle id, then display name); cua.getApp('Finder') succeeded, so the CU server itself was healthy
environment_note.screen_change_vs_probe: full-image MAD 59.063; 3401699 / 3418060 pixels changed > 8 gray levels

full_screen_template_search.note: MAD 34.029 (vs 3.678 on the probe) means the window content is not present anywhere on the current screen - the LINE window was closed, minimised, or moved to another Space

environment_note.stop: read-only stop; no retry; owner direction required before any further step (Rev20 §20.3)

notes: screencapture -x is read-only: it sends no input event, produces no sound, and neither raises nor activates any window.
The crop rectangles are the located window region of the same probe (analysis derivatives; no additional capture).
Frame and crop bytes are never committed (attempt-03 policy); only bytes/size/SHA-256 are recorded and the files stay in /tmp so Stage 05 can re-run the frozen tools on them.
